kurz: Start part of the flour, water and a little yeast hours ahead. It brings flavour and strength to the main dough.
bild_im_kopf: Like an advance party that goes ahead and sets up camp.
was_passiert: In a preferment the yeast works for a long time with little food. Aromas and acids form, and the [[glutenbildung|gluten proteins]] hydrate. In the main dough, the preferment brings flavour and better structure without the whole dough having to prove for so long.
schritte: The evening before, mix flour, water and a pinch of yeast.
Cover and leave at room temperature for 12–16 hours until bubbly.
Mix with the remaining flour, water and salt into the main dough.
